title: NA60032: Advanced Ship Design
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Types of warships: principal dimensions and form coefficients, warship design
procedures, general arrangement, special hull forms. Design considerations:
mass and space, stability, hydrodynamics (resistance, propulsion, seakeeping,
manoeuvring), survivability, strength, cost effectiveness, reliability and
maintainability, vibration. Ship measurements: deadweight, capacity and
tonnage. Machinery and equipment: propulsion, power generation, boats and
davits. Systems design: piping, electrical distribution, air conditioning and
ventilation, cathodic protection.
